title: Evidence Claim (claim <= proof)
description: A single public claim classified as DOWOD | GAP | NARRACJA. Enforces: DOWOD needs proof_ref; GAP needs roadmap_ref and future phrasing; NARRACJA must be labelled.

proof_ref.description: Resolvable reference an independent party can re-run/inspect (URL, file+hash, commit, test id).

phrased_as_future.description: For GAP: the statement is worded as roadmap, not as done.

repo_status_ref.description: Optional. Points a single claim at the x-k0nsult.status of a whole repo (see k0nsult-eu-shield/osor/PUBLICCODE-GENERATOR-SPEC.md SS4.1.1 and k0nsult-tools/schema/x-k0nsult.schema.json), so a claim can lean on a repo-level status declaration instead of duplicating its semantics inline. Recommended shape: '<repo-name>#x-k0nsult.status' (e.g. 'k0nsult-chain#x-k0nsult.status'). This field does NOT substitute for proof_ref/roadmap_ref — it is an additional cross-reference, never a replacement for the class-specific evidence a claim already requires.

then.description: A DOWOD without a proof_ref is invalid — downgrade to GAP.
A GAP must carry a roadmap_ref and be phrased as future.
